structure.name: Cho'Gath
structure.background:
Born from the unspeakable darkness of the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void"), Cho'Gath exists solely to consume matter. As a Voidborn, it has been part of a relentless effort to breach the barriers between dimensions and invade Runeterra for millennia. Now, Cho'Gath preys on anyone and anything that ventures near the center of the Void Rift in Icathia.

## Appearance
structure.appearance:
Cho'Gath is massive behemoth who towers over its adversaries, growing larger with every creature it devours. Its massive form is covered in a hardened, purplish-red carapace. Its visage features multiple rows of razor-sharp teeth within a gaping maw. Cho'Gath possesses six appendages: two ending in powerful pincers, two ending in scythe-like spikes, and two clawed legs. Flanking its maw are two horns that curve forward towards its face.

## Personality
structure.personality:
Cho'Gath is an entity driven by an unrelenting and insatiable hunger. It embodies the all-consuming desire of the Void to consume all life and bring about chaos and destruction. Despite being primal in nature, Cho'Gath possesses a certain level of intelligence. It revels in the fear and terror it instills in others, taking pleasure in its violent predations.

## Abilities
structure.abilities:
As a [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn"), Cho'Gath is able to evolve and grow, becoming increasingly formidable. Some of its known abilities include:

- **[Rupture](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Rupture "Cho'Gath")**: Cho'Gath slams the ground, causing devastating seismic ruptures that erupt beneath enemies, launching them into the air and dealing damage.
- **[Feral Scream](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Feral_Scream "Cho'Gath")**: With a terrifying roar, Cho'Gath emits a sonic blast that silences and damages nearby enemies, rendering them unable to cast spells.
- **[Vorpal Spikes](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Vorpal_Spikes "Cho'Gath")**: Cho'Gath can unleash a barrage of spikes from its body, impaling and damaging enemies in a wide area.
- **[Feast](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Cho%27Gath#Feast "Cho'Gath")**: Cho'Gath's signature ability, it devours its enemies, dealing massive damage and growing in size and strength with each kill.

## Relations

structure.name: Kai'Sa
structure.quote: *"My appearance may frighten you, but make no mistake—I am on your side, and we fight to the bitter end."*
structure.background:
### Early life

Kaisa was an ordinary girl born in the southern deserts of Shurima. During her tenth summer, she came upon a pen of sacrificial goats. The girl tried to release the animals but then, suddenly, the ground shook, flashes of light scorched the sky, and a rift opened up the earth. The rift swallowed up the entire village and everyone inside.

Now trapped under the desert, Kaisa could hear the faint voices of others trapped inside. But soon, hers was the only voice left. The first void creature she encountered was about her size. After being knocked down by the voidling, Kaisa drove her knife into its heart, killing it.

Although the creature was dead, its flesh clung to Kaisa’s arm. She was unable to remove it and soon enough, it started growing around her as though it was becoming part of her. She was able to use the second skin as armor against other void creatures. The longer she survived against the void, the greater her confidence grew until she finally managed to escape back to the desert surface. No longer was she the little girl who fell into the rift but was now a fearless hunter of the void.

### Protecting [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") from [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn")

:   *Main article: [The Girl Who Came Back](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Girl_Who_Came_Back "The Girl Who Came Back")*
:   *Main article: [Monstrous](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Monstrous "Monstrous")*

After many years below the surface, Kai'Sa rememerges to the surface. A young girl named Illi discovers Kai'Sa beside a pit. Kai'Sa guides Illi on how to confront the impending Void threat. Illi, brave and determined, stands by Kai'Sa's side as they face Void creatures. Kai'Sa imparts the wisdom she gained from fighting the [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn") over the years to Illi. She advises her to starve the Void and explains the necessity of running at times. When Illi's village searches for her, Kai'Sa encourages Illi to go to her father and prepares her for the challenges ahead.

In the depths of the earth, Kai'Sa navigates the Void-infested underworld. She finds a leader of a nearby settlement up on the surface. She captures him in order to show him the imminent threat below. As they journey through treacherous tunnels, Kai'Sa reflects on her altered perception, her symbiotic relationship with the living armor, and the sacrifices she made to survive in the darkness.

As they emerge closer to the surface than expected, Kai'Sa realizes the urgency of the impending Void threat. The leader, initially blind to the darkness, witnesses the horrors of the abyss. Thousands of [monstrous creatures](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn") emerge, their malevolent intent clear. Kai'Sa confronts the leader, urging him to understand the danger and protect his people. The leader, still blind to the imminent threat his people face, pleads to be released. Kai'Sa contemplates the morality of her actions, torn between saving lives and succumbing to her predatory instincts. The living armor hungers for the leader's essence, but she resists, determined to safeguard the surface.

Fighting through the creatures, Kai'Sa brings the leader back to the surface, only to discover a settlement unaware of the imminent danger. Setting a warning marker, she realizes her past actions inadvertently attracted the [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn"). Panic ensues as she unleashes destructive energy to force the settlement's evacuation. As night falls, Kai'Sa stands on a rock spire, witnessing the approaching Void horde. The settlement evacuates, harboring fear and hatred for the once-human girl. Kai'Sa embraces her role as their protector, ready to face the monsters and become the necessary monster to ensure the survival of those she now considers her people.

### Attempt to reclaim [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan")

:   *Main article: [Hollowspun](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Hollowspun "Hollowspun")*
:   *Main article: [The Call](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/The_Call "The Call")*

In the desolate void-ridden landscape, Kai'Sa, navigates a purposeful Void tunnel that defies the chaotic nature of the Void. As she confronts the newly discovered [Voidborn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn") she dubs "Lamplights", she battles relentlessly, only to find herself overwhelmed. In a twist of fate,  [Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taliyah "Universe:Taliyah") rescues Kai'Sa from the clutches of the Lamplights. Together, they return to a community of survivors in Taliyah's camp, where initial fear and skepticism towards Kai'Sa gradually transform into trust and acceptance through shared meals and vulnerable moments.

Amidst the flickering firelight and the scent of roasting meat, Kai'Sa contends not only with her physical injuries but also the weight of the survivors' gaze, haunted by the fear of the unknown.  **Kai'Sa** begins to understand the power of alliances and the shared struggle against the pervasive darkness, as she decides to stay and heal.

As the group shares tales of their losses and hopes, Kai'Sa remains skeptical of a mythical sanctuary called [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan"), proposed by a fellow survivor. Tensions rise when Taliyah expresses determination to lead the group to Xolan, across the [Sai Kahleek](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sai_Kahleek "Sai Kahleek"). Kai'Sa warns of the perils, revealing her firsthand knowledge of the deadly [Xer'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xer%27Sai "Xer'Sai") that infest the area. Despite her objections, Taliyah, fueled by hope and a plan to build stone bridges for safe passage, remains resolute in her quest.

As the survivors cross the [Sai Kahleek](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sai_Kahleek "Sai Kahleek") desert, they encounter a nest of [Xer'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xer%27Sai "Xer'Sai"). Kai'Sa takes matters into her own hands to protect the group, but the situation escalates as a colossal 6 [Xer'sai Dunebreaker](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/LoR:Xer%27sai_Dunebreaker "LoR:Xer'sai Dunebreaker") emerges, threatening the survivors. After barely defeating the Voidborn and saving the survivors, they contemplate a new destination. Taliyah agrees with Kai'Sa that there is no save haven. So Taliyah decides to make one. Kai'Sa and Taliyah set out to Xolan alone in order to defeat the Xer'Sai that live their and make Xolan a safe haven for all the Southern people of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima").

Taliyah and Kai'Sa arrived in [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan") to find the town abandoned and destroyed. They were then attacked by a group of [Xer'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xer%27Sai "Xer'Sai"), but fended them off before a sinkhole appeared in the ground.  [Rek'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Rek%27Sai "Universe:Rek'Sai") emerged from the pit, and Kai'Sa lured her back underground. This allowed Taliyah to bring the statue of  [Xolaani](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Xolaani "Universe:Xolaani"), the 'faceless god', over the sinkhole to prevent Rek'Sai from re-emerging.

### Encounter with Bel'Veth

:   *Main article: [All That Will Ever Be](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/All_That_Will_Ever_Be "All That Will Ever Be")*
:   *Main article: [Pinwheel](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Pinwheel "Pinwheel")*

After plunging back into the  [Void](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Void "Universe:Void")-invested grounds of southern  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima"), Kai'Sa found herself ensnared in the depths of the [Lavender Sea](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lavender_Sea "Lavender Sea"). Navigating through the unnatural environment, she eventually came face to face with its monstrous empress,  [Bel'Veth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27Veth "Universe:Bel'Veth"). Overwhelmed by the empress's formidable strength, Kai'Sa succumbed swiftly, defeated and confined to one of the many grotesque walls that adorned the fake sea.

Within the ominous presence of Bel'Veth, Kai'Sa's reality shattered anew as the empress unveiled the haunting truth about her father,  [Kassadin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kassadin "Universe:Kassadin"). Though still alive, the Void had shattered Kassadin's mind, leaving him lost in the ancient abyss. As Kai'Sa grappled with the shock of her father's existence, Bel'Veth delved into the history of the Void, explaining the symbiotic corruption between the Void and reality, where both realms influenced and tainted each other.

Bel'Veth presented Kai'Sa with an ultimatum. The survival of the world hinged on an uneasy alliance – Kai'Sa must assist the empress in eradicating her progenitors, the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher"). In return, Bel'Veth offered Kai'Sa time to devise a plan to defeat her, confident in the belief that the girl stood no chance against her might. Ordering Kai'Sa to "find the Watchers and confirm the truth," Bel'Veth released her captive, prompting Kai'Sa to instinctively rocket towards the surface, escaping the [Lavender Sea](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lavender_Sea "Lavender Sea").

## Appearance
structure.appearance:
Kai'Sa is a slender, pale-skinned woman with long dark brown hair and violet eyes. Her robes are composed of a Void Symbiote with a distinct palette of grey, dark grey, purple and bronze. The most distinctive ornaments of her attire are some purple marks on her face.

## Personality
structure.personality:
Spending many years alone in the Void-infested [Shuriman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima") catacombs away from humanity has made Kai'sa very stoic, calculative and not very communicative. Despite her horrible circumstances, she still longs to be with other people and is still capable of connecting with others like  [Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taliyah "Universe:Taliyah") and  [Ezreal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ezreal "Universe:Ezreal"). She has shown to have a strong sense of duty towards the other desert-dwelling people of  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Shurima "Universe:Shurima") as she acts as their silent protector against Void predators despite the possible disdain she might receive from revealing herself.

## Abilities
structure.abilities:
- **Void Symbiote:** When Kai'sa was stuck in a cave connected to the Void, Kai'sa was attached to a Void symbiote. The symbiote grants Kai'sa many different powers.
  - **Organic Armor:** The symbiote's carapace provides a powerful defense against the harmful effects of the Void on living humans, allowing Kai'sa to pass throught dangerous territories across Runeterra.
  - **Void Energy Projection:** Kai'sa can project void energy in the form of missiles to decimate her foes.
  - **Enhanced Senses:** When wearing her helmet, Kai'sa has enhanced senses, like seeing in different light spectrums.

## Relations

relations.relationship_description: Kaisa unwittingly released the sacrificial goats meant for  [Malzahar](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Malzahar "Universe:Malzahar")'s cultists into a Void-linked canyon as a prank to a transiting desert nomad, causing an earthquake that devastated her village, swallowing and killing all inhabitants except herself, who survived thanks to the symbiote suit and learning the Voidborns' methods of predation

[Kassadin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kassadin "Universe:Kassadin") lived in the same village as Kai'sa before the village was engulfed by The Void. The event killed Kassadin's wife and child, causing Kassadin to go on his quest for revenge against The Void. While is has not been confirmed, a prevailing theory among players is that Kai'sa is Kassadin's daughter. While their relationship in the main universe has not been formally confirmed, it has been implied through voice lines and in the  [Four Beasts](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Four_Beasts "Universe:Four Beasts"),  [Riot Records](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Riot_Records "Universe:Riot Records"), and  [Star Guardian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Star_Guardian "Universe:Star Guardian") universes, Kassadin is  [K/DA Kai'Sa's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kai%27Sa/Cosmetics "Kai'Sa/Cosmetics") father.[[1]](#cite_note-1)[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3)  [Bel'Veth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27Veth "Universe:Bel'Veth") reveals that Kai'Sa's father was the only other person to survive the Void, the only person being  [Kassadin](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kassadin "Universe:Kassadin").
Kai'Sa saved  [Ezreal](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ezreal "Universe:Ezreal") when he was attacked by Void creatures. Ezreal later helped her fight them.

Kai'Sa encountered  [Taliyah](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Taliyah "Universe:Taliyah") and her group on their journey to find [Xolan](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xolan "Xolan"), a mythical paradise in [Sai Kahleek](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sai_Kahleek "Sai Kahleek"). They fought some void creatures together, including some of  [Rek'Sai's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Rek%27Sai "Rek'Sai") [Xer'Sai](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Xer%27Sai "Xer'Sai"). Taliyah would then part way with the others and join Kai'Sa in going there.

[Bel'Veth](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Bel%27Veth "Universe:Bel'Veth") is an enemy of Kai'Sa, Naturally feeling animosity towards the empress, Kai'Sa was shocked when Bel'Veth revealed she and her motives were more than a simple [Voidborn's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Voidborn "Voidborn"), talking about how she would be her salvation and even making a pragmatic deal to spare humanity so she would defeat the [Watchers](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Watcher "Watcher").

structure.trivia:
- She is around 20 years old.
  - She was 10 when she fell into the Void tunnel and has stayed there for about 10 years.
- Kai'Sa is 169.6 cm (5’6”) in height like her  [K/DA counterpart](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kai%27Sa/Cosmetics "Kai'Sa/Cosmetics").[[4]](#cite_note-4)
  - Her  [Star Guardian counterpart](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kai%27Sa/Cosmetics "Kai'Sa/Cosmetics") is around 180 cm (5'11)[[5]](#cite_note-5)
  - Her  [Bullet Angel counterpart](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kai%27Sa/Cosmetics "Kai'Sa/Cosmetics") is between 165 and 172 cm (5’5"-5'8")[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Kaisa is her given name, Kai'Sa is her adopted Void name.
- Her symbiote can sustain her through the Void-spawns they kill by absorbing their essence, but that isn't really pleasing to her. After the earthquake she unwittingly caused, she scavenged leftover food from castaway sources in the catacombs— water skins, rotting fruit, etc. Now that she can get out from the underground, she likes eating what she can find around  [Shurima](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shurima "Shurima"), preferably peaches. But the suit has to feed too, and she is somewhat fearful of what it might do if she doesn't continue to hunt and sustain it.
  - Due to her symbiote, Kai'Sa is stronger than normal humans while gaining abilities like blasting  [destructive energy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kai%27Sa#Icathian_Rain "Kai'Sa"), especially when wearing her helmet-like empowered senses (like a special vision that is either thermoreception or X-ray vision).
- Despite common belief, Kaisa was never trapped in the Void itself, rather willingly stayed within a complex underground tunnel system between the massive Void rift that caused the earthquake of her lore and the surface of the Sai desert, sculpted through years by the spawns that breach from the rift.
- The lines that decorate her face are tribal marks made out of Voidborn blood.
- Unlike other beings exposed to the Void's influence, Kaisa was able to avoid its seething madness thanks to her suit's helmet, which allows her to safely remain within the vicinity of Void rifts.
- It has been theorized that the creature whose part would later become her second skin belonged to the same species as  [Kha'Zix](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Kha%27Zix "Universe:Kha'Zix").
  - One of her quotes to him is "I know your tricks".
  - Both the symbiote and Kha'zix evolve to become stronger.
    - Both have the potential to become invisible and shoot more projectiles after certain evolutions.

structure.name: Darius
structure.quote: *"History only remembers the victors. Stand with  [Noxus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus"), and be remembered forever."*
structure.background:
### Childhood

Born in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Basilich "Universe:Basilich"), Darius was as an orphan alongside his younger brother  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Draven "Draven"). He struggled hard to provide for both himself and his brother and protected the latter from anyone who tried to harm him, even the city guard. Darius spent a majority of his childhood fighting for survival, with constant fights leaving permanent scars on himself. He and Draven were friends with a girl named  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn"), whom saved him from falling off a cliff that they were climbing. Darius developed a relationship with Quilletta, having ambitions to conquer the world alongside her.

When an  [Noxian](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Noxus "Universe:Noxus") army led by their captain  [Cyrus](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Cyrus "Universe:Cyrus") invaded Basilich, the three children hid atop a rooftop. Quilletta was reluctant towards the harsh choice between joining Noxus or being killed, but Darius contemplated paying the consequences since he didn't want to leave Draven behind. To his horror, Draven attempted to throw a knife to fight them but ended up hitting Cyrus' flag, leading to the three to get apprehended by the soldiers. After hearing Draven's boasts, Cyrus invited the kids to ally with Noxus.

### In Noxus

Growing to adulthood in Noxus, Darius married Quilletta and became a father to two: Decius and  [Invetia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn"). He and Draven served as soldiers under Cyrus' warhost, engaging in many war campaigns and stopping rebellions against  [Boram Darkwill's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Boram_Darkwill "Universe:Boram Darkwill") throne. Darius quickly rose through the ranks, embodying the values of Noxus through his aggression, bravery and patriotism. In one battle, after a general ordered a retreat, Darius saw him as a coward and beheaded him out of defiance, rallying the fearful troops and securing a victory. He was rewarded by being promoted to senior commander, which attracted many Noxians to join his army but he only accepted those with the greatest strength and discipline. Feared to the point where cities surrendered at the sight of Darius' banners, his victory against the Varju got him promoted to the Hand of Noxus by Darkwill himself.

As the new Hand of Noxus, Darius and his army were sent to the Freljord to conquer it, enduring countless assassination attempts, a conflictive territorial dispute between the [trolls](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Troll "Universe:Troll") under  [Trundle's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trundle "Universe:Trundle") command in the steppes at the borders of the icy lands, and a capture from the  [Winter's Claw](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Winter%27s_Claw "Universe:Winter's Claw") before ending in a stalemate after a long, grueling conflict. He headed back to Noxus to request a reconsolidation of the military, but found that Darkwill had been assassinated and usurped by  [Jericho Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain"), as part of his coup which even Draven had backed. Darius began to respect Swain's accomplishments and was prepared to serve him, but he gave Darius a place in the  [Trifarian Legion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Trifarian_Legion "Universe:Trifarian Legion"), representing the Noxian principle of Might alongside Swain as Vision and the Faceless as Guile.

However, Quilletta was starting to become disillusioned towards Noxus after witnessing the horrific aftermath of  [Singed's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") chemical bomb in Ionia, which caused her arm to be amputated as a result of the poison, and their son Decius dying in the campaign against the Freljord. Quilletta expressed her worries to Darius, but he dismissed her saying that Noxus required mercilessness and sacrifice because the empire had to conquer and losing one city would be severely detrimental. Finally having enough, Quilletta snapped from her grief towards Decius' death only to be killed by Invetia, believing her to be weak. Horrified, Darius asked Invetia about her merciless act, and she cited the Noxian philosophy and how she learned it from him.

## Appearance
structure.appearance:
Darius is a large, bulky man with a serious, intense face and middle-aged features. He has fair skin and swept-back black hair with a white streak. His eyes are variously portrayed as either red, green or gray. He also has a long, straight scar over his left eye.

Darius wears heavy full plate armor that leaves only his head and his upper arms exposed. It is dark gray, intricately crafted, and accentuated with spikes around the shoulders and thighs. It also features a long cape and loin cloth, both blood red, symbolizing Noxus.

His weapon of choice is a massive two-handed axe, viciously curved and forged with a symbol of a skull where the blade meets the handle.

## Personality
structure.personality:
Stern and warlike, Darius is unwaveringly dedicated to Noxus and its ideals. He is a soldier without parallel, balancing ruthless mettle with sound strategy. He stands confident and firm, showing no tolerance for weakness or cowardice. Despite his intimidating demeanor, however, Darius is also deeply committed to fostering the strength of others wherever he can find it, elevating those he finds deserving and crushing those who have not earned their status.

## Abilities
structure.abilities:
- **[Master Axeman](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darius#Decimate "Darius"):** Through his countless battles within the Noxian campaigns, Darius became very adept at using his battle axe in combat. He became so feared that he would make cities surrender by the mere sight of his banners as well as grant him the miltary title of Hand of Noxus.
- **Extreme Resilience:** From a young age, Darius exhibited remarkable resilience to injury and pain. His body bears the visible scars of numerous battles, a testament to his enduring strength. Born an urchin in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Basilich "Basilich") and the elder brother to  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven"), Darius had to fight not only to survive but also to provide for his sibling. This innate toughness became even more apparent during his military campaigns.
- **Charisma:** Darius is very charismatic in the eyes of the Noxian troops. After a general ordered a retreat, Darius saw him as a coward and beheaded him out of defiance, rallying the fearful troops and securing a victory. He is also known to accept anyone who is willing and able to fight for their ideals, no matter the cost.

## Relations

relations.relationship_description: Darius was accoladed by Darkwill, but allied with  [Swain](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Swain "Universe:Swain") because he sees in the Master Tactician someone who can make Noxus rise.

In Darius' eyes  [necromancy](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") is cheating death to justify one's undeserved continued survival.[[1]](#cite_note-1) Yet for him,  [Sion's](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Sion "Universe:Sion") legacy is an example. Though when he gazes upon the Undead Juggernaut, he sees what might become of himself should he no longer be useful to the empire (or rather, too useful, should death come knocking).[[2]](#cite_note-2)

Darius holds no grudge against  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen"). However, he considers him a fool bound by a meaningless code of "honor." Despite this, he would relish killing  [Garen](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Garen "Universe:Garen") simply to prove  [Noxian Might](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darius#Hemorrhage_2 "Darius") crushes all, even Demacian  [Perseverance](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen#Perseverance "Garen"),  [Courage](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen#Courage "Garen"), and  [Justice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Garen#Demacian_Justice "Garen")—especially a paragon of said values.[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Darius and his younger brother  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") are renowned as the "Blood Brothers." Family ties are strong and can serve as the basis for one's strength, yet Darius sees self-serving aristocrats using theirs as a crutch for their weakness, and as a result, the perpetuation of stagnant leadership that needs to be removed and replaced. With this in mind, one cannot tell if Darius providing and caring for  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven") during their childhood came out of love or even mere pragmatism. The comic *Blood of Noxus* seems to imply the former.

He has 2 children (Decius and  [Invetia Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn")) mothered by his former lover,  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn"). They never married given the pragmatism of Noxus, and knowing the likely trajectory of their lives at war.[[4]](#cite_note-4) She was murdered by their daughter  [Invetia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn") during the [Battle of Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Blood_of_Noxus "Universe:Blood of Noxus").

While it was never explicitly confirmed that they are his children, it was heavily implied due to the relationship between Darius and Quilletta as well as some localizations using terms indicative of blood relation.

Seeing the approval of the slaughtering of innocents by  [Singed](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Singed "Universe:Singed") and Emystan made  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn") grow more disillusioned about the empire's ambitions, which led her to rebel against the empire, among the other events of the story.

During his campaign in the  [Freljord](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Freljord "Universe:Freljord"), Darius fought Trundle and was nearly killed by him. Darius' axe was frozen by Trundle's [True Ice](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:True_Ice "Universe:True Ice") club, but he was able to use it to knock the king of the trolls unconscious, with his arm becoming injured and frozen in the process.[[5]](#cite_note-Welcome_to_Noxus-5)

During a Black Mist attack caused by  [Viego](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Viego "Universe:Viego") at the [Immortal Bastion](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Immortal_Bastion "Universe:The Immortal Bastion"), Darius was temporarily possessed and fought  [Samira](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Samira "Universe:Samira") before the Mist retreated.

structure.trivia:
- He is between his mid and late 30s.
- **Darius**,  [Draven](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Draven "Universe:Draven"),  [Invetia](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Invetia_Varn "Universe:Invetia Varn"), and  [Quilletta Varn](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Quilletta_Varn "Universe:Quilletta Varn") were all born in [Basilich](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Basilich "Basilich").
- "*Darius isn't a crazed, bloodthirsty maniac but more of a cold-blooded killer moving through the battlefield with powerful, precise movements and striking with deadly force where it matters most. He takes pride in combat, but there's no primal bloodlust needing to be sated. Unpredictable sadists don't always make for the best commanders.*" — [Harrow](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Iain_%27Harrow%27_Hendry "Iain 'Harrow' Hendry"), narrative writer for Riot.[[6]](#cite_note-6)
- Darius's *Trifarian Legion* is probably based on the [Triarii](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Triarii), the elite unit in the [Roman Republic](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_Republic)'s early period ​legions​s;
  - The stem *Trifar-* is possibly based on [Latin](//en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classical_Latin) *trifārius* "in three parts~places" (cf. Sanskrit cognate त्रिधा *tridhā*), from PIE [*\*tri-*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Reconstruction:Proto-Indo-European/tri-)[*dʰóh₁-*](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Reconstruction:Proto-Indo-European/d%CA%B0eh%E2%82%81-).[[7]](#cite_note-7)
- Having been raised as an orphan, Darius doesn't care for titles or privileges—only to serve his empire through  [Noxian Might](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Darius#Hemorrhage "Darius").[[8]](#cite_note-8)
- His armor and axe were likely made with ore from the [Delverhold](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:The_Delverhold "Universe:The Delverhold") of the [Ironspike Mountains](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Universe:Ironspike_Mountains "Universe:Ironspike Mountains").[[9]](#cite_note-9)
